Package neqsim.process.equipment.energy

Class CompressorPowerTrain.Result

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.energy.CompressorPowerTrain.Result
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
CompressorPowerTrain
public static final class CompressorPowerTrain.Result extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable supply-side operating point; powers are positive in W and mass rates in kg/s.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • Result

      private Result(CompressorPowerTrain.Mode mode, double requiredPowerW, double deliveredPowerW, double availablePowerW, double electricalInputW, double turbineShaftW, double conversionLossW, double fuelEnergyW, double fuelMassKgPerS, double co2KgPerS, boolean belowMinimumLoad)
      Creates an immutable result.
      Parameters:
      mode - supply topology
      requiredPowerW - requested mechanical output in W
      deliveredPowerW - delivered mechanical output in W
      availablePowerW - available mechanical output in W
      electricalInputW - motor and auxiliary electrical demand in W
      turbineShaftW - turbine shaft output in W
      conversionLossW - generator, motor and auxiliary losses in W, excluding turbine exhaust heat
      fuelEnergyW - fuel LHV energy input in W
      fuelMassKgPerS - fuel mass flow in kg/s
      co2KgPerS - fuel-derived carbon dioxide rate in kg/s
      belowMinimumLoad - whether the turbine is below its stable-load screening limit
